# Data sets 

We use the following data sets to validate findings from MB119: 

  - *in-vivo IM/Atrophy* data sets:
     - Nookaew et al., BMC Medical Genomics 2013. GSE27411. n=3 samples from non-infected patients (antrum and corpus) and unpaired samples from patients with atrophy (antrum and corpus). Illumina humanRef-8 v2.0 beadchip.
     - Companioni et al., PlosOne 2017. GSE78523. n=15 (11 Antrum, 4 Body). Affymetrix Human Almac Xcel Array
     - Thorell et al., Infection & Immunity 2017 (DOI: 10.1128/IAI.00031-17). E-MTAB-3689; n=25 RNA-Seq of gastritis, mild atrophy, extensive atrophy/IM
     
  - *in-vitro* data sets of stomach and intestine:
     - Colon (van Wetering et al.; DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2015.03.053) vs. Stomach (Bartfeld et al. Gastroenterology 2015. GSE60557. 2A/2C gland derived organoids). Both hybridized to Affymetrix Human Gene 2.0 ST Arrays. 
     - Kayisoglu et al. (Bartfeld lab, DOI 10.1136/gutjnl-2019-319919). GSE127938. 3 samples each from human stomach antrum + corpus ("stomach"), cranial intestine (duodenum, jejunum) and caudal intestine (ileum, colon) cultured as organoids and subjected to RNA-Seq
     - Zhenshou/China Small intestine vs. stomach
     
  - *ex-vivo* data sets of healthy and metaplastic stomach
     - Zhenshou/China IM vs non-IM 
     - MPIIB ESGIv2 IM vs. non-IM
     - MPIIB ESGIv2 IM vs. normal stomach
     
For each data set we compare Atrophy/IM vs. healthy/control conditions in stomach or large/small intestine vs. stomach samples.

# Genes

REG4, ISG15, IFI27 - up in metasplastic cells  
AQP8, CLCA4, CA1, HOXA13 - colonocyte markers  
APOA1, APOA4, HOXC11, ALDOB - enterocyte markers (proximal)  
DEFA5, DEFA6 - Paneth cell markers  
KRT7, HES1 - IM cells  
REG1A, OLFM4 - SI TA/SC  
MUC12, MUC5B - LI TA/SC  
MUC6, LZY, LIPF - Sto TA/SC  
MUC5AC - Sto Pit
ALPI,TREH,ANPEP, SI - markers of complete IM (Matsukura et al.). SI is unclear as it is a brush border enzyme but also reported in incomplete IM
AXIN2 - Wnt
TBX3 - candidate gene DM
HOXB7

# Plots

```{r}
extract_table_ts <- function(ds) {
  emat = ds[["emat"]]
  anno = ds[["anno"]]
  ed = ds[["sample_description"]]
  
  sel_probes = subset(anno, SYMBOL %in% sel_genes)

  emat_sel = emat[sel_probes$PROBE_ID,order(ed[colnames(emat),]$Condition), drop=F]

  emat_ts = reshape2::melt(emat_sel, stringsAsFactors=F)
  colnames(emat_ts) = c("PROBE_ID","SampleID","Expression")
  emat_ts$PROBE_ID = as.character(emat_ts$PROBE_ID)
  emat_ts$SampleID = as.character(emat_ts$SampleID)
  emat_ts = merge(emat_ts, ed, by="SampleID", sort=F)
  emat_ts$Condition = paste0(toupper(substr(emat_ts$Condition,1,1)),substr(emat_ts$Condition,2,nchar(emat_ts$Condition)))
  emat_ts = merge(emat_ts, anno, by="PROBE_ID", all.x=T, sort=F)
  
  return(emat_ts)
  
}
```


```{r}

combined_tabs = as.data.table(do.call(rbind, lapply(all_ds, extract_table_ts)))

condition_levels_ordered = c("Healthy stomach","Intestinal/-like")

combined_tabs$Condition = factor(combined_tabs$Condition, levels=condition_levels_ordered)


combined_tabs$Cohort = factor(cohort_old_to_new[combined_tabs$Cohort], levels = cohort_old_to_new)

combined_tabs[, mean_stomach:=mean(ifelse(Condition=="Healthy stomach",Expression,NA), na.rm=T), by=c("Cohort","SYMBOL","PROBE_ID")]
combined_tabs[,Expression_antrum_centered:=Expression-mean_stomach]
```



```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=4, eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

for (gg in sel_genes) {
  
  emat_ts = subset(combined_tabs, SYMBOL==gg)
  if(nrow(emat_ts)<1) next
  p = ggplot(emat_ts, aes(x=Condition, y=Expression)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill=Cohort)) + facet_grid(~ Cohort + PROBE_ID) + ggtitle(gg) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) + geom_point()
  print(p)
  
}

```


## Relative to Healthy Stomach

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE}
all_plots = list()


for (gg in sel_genes) {
  emat_ts = subset(combined_tabs, SYMBOL==gg & Condition %in% c("Healthy stomach","Intestinal/-like"))
  emat_ts$Cohort2 <- gsub(",[ ]*", "\n", as.character(emat_ts$Cohort)) |> factor(levels=gsub(",[ ]*", "\n", levels(emat_ts$Cohort)))

  emat_ts_avg <- emat_ts[, .(Expression_antrum_centered=mean(Expression_antrum_centered)), by=c("Condition","Cohort2","SampleID")]
  
  ymin = min(-3,min(emat_ts_avg$Expression_antrum_centered))
  ymax = max(3, max(emat_ts_avg$Expression_antrum_centered))

  p = ggplot(emat_ts_avg, aes(x=Condition, y=Expression_antrum_centered)) + 
    #stat_summary(fun.y = mean, fun.ymin = mean, fun.ymax = mean,  geom="crossbar",width=0.5, aes(col=Site)) + 
    stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom="bar",width=0.5, aes(col=Condition)) + 
    geom_point(aes(col=Condition)) + 
    facet_nested(~  Cohort2) + ggtitle(gg) +
    #theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), strip.text.x = element_text(angle=0, hjust=0, size=10)) + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(ymin,ymax)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col="grey") + 
    stat_compare_means(method="t.test", aes(label = paste0(..p.signif..," (p=",..p.format..,")")), label.y = ymax*0.9, label.x = 0.9) + 
    ylab("Expression relative to healthy stomach mean")
  all_plots[[gg]] = p
  print(p)
}
```
